name: zsnd_sample_set_registry_destroy_all
description: zSndSampleSetRegistry::DestroyAll destroys every registered sample set, clears slots, and resets the registry end cursor to begin.
known_limits: Tier C only; no VC COFF byte-comparison target exists yet, so tier S remains open.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja assembly/decompilation at 0x4a0880 validates walking registry begin to end, calling zSndSampleSet::DestroyOwnedData and operator delete for non-null entries, nulling each slot, and setting registry end back to begin.
The native smoke covers lookup behavior and a heap-owned DestroyAll pass that nulls slots and resets the registry end cursor.
